description: Frontend features: AdminRoute guard, DevotionalAdmin three-tab page, useDevotionalRealtime hook wired to Devotionals and DevotionalDetail pages, MediaUpload component, Login.tsx UX hardening, App.tsx route addition, AppLayout.tsx admin nav link. Independent of FEAT-001 at the TypeScript level only if the tRPC router types are already available via src/types/trpc-router.ts — implement AFTER FEAT-001 because the new trpc.devotional.create/update/delete/publish, trpc.telegram.messages, and trpc.media.* procedures must exist on AppRouter before the frontend code type-checks.
steps: Step 1 — src/components/AdminRoute.tsx (NEW FILE): import useAuth from '@/hooks/useAuth', useNavigate and useEffect from 'react-router'. Props: { children: React.ReactNode }. Logic: const { user, isLoading } = useAuth(). If isLoading, render a centered spinner matching the Loading component pattern in App.tsx. useEffect: if (!isLoading && user && user.role !== 'admin' && user.role !== 'elevated_admin') navigate('/'). Also handle !isLoading && !user case by navigating to '/login'. Return <>{children}</> when authorized.

Step 2 — src/hooks/useDevotionalRealtime.ts (NEW FILE): import { useEffect } from 'react'. import { trpc } from '@/providers/trpc'. import { supabase } from '@/lib/supabase'. Export default function useDevotionalRealtime(): void. Inside: const utils = trpc.useUtils(). useEffect with empty dep array: const channel = supabase.channel('devotionals').on('broadcast', { event: 'devotional_changed' }, () => { utils.devotional.list.invalidate(); utils.devotional.today.invalidate(); }).subscribe(). Return cleanup: () => { supabase.removeChannel(channel); }.

Step 3 — src/pages/Devotionals.tsx: Add import useDevotionalRealtime from '@/hooks/useDevotionalRealtime'. Call useDevotionalRealtime() at the top of the component body (after existing hooks). No other changes to this file.

Step 4 — src/pages/DevotionalDetail.tsx: Add import useDevotionalRealtime from '@/hooks/useDevotionalRealtime'. Call useDevotionalRealtime() at the top of the component body. No other changes to this file.

Step 5 — src/components/MediaUpload.tsx (NEW FILE): Props interface: { onUpload: (url: string) => void; accept?: string; label?: string }. State: file (File|null), progress (number 0-100), status ('idle'|'uploading'|'archiving'|'done'|'error'), errorMsg (string). Render: a styled file input button (matches amber theme), a Radix Progress bar (import from @radix-ui/react-progress) shown during upload, and an error message. On file selection: (1) call trpc.media.uploadUrl.mutate({fileName: file.name, mimeType: file.type, folder: 'devotionals'}) to get {uploadUrl, fields}. (2) Build FormData with all fields + the file. (3) Use XMLHttpRequest POST to uploadUrl; wire xhr.upload.onprogress to update progress state. (4) On load (status 200/201): parse JSON response for secure_url. (5) Call trpc.media.archiveToSupabase.mutate({cloudinaryUrl: secure_url, fileName: file.name}). (6) Call onUpload(secure_url). On error at any step: set status 'error' and errorMsg.

Step 6 — src/pages/admin/DevotionalAdmin.tsx (NEW FILE, create directory src/pages/admin/ first): Use Radix Tabs (@radix-ui/react-tabs already installed). Three TabsTrigger: 'new' / 'manage' / 'telegram'. Import trpc from '@/providers/trpc'. Import useAuth from '@/hooks/useAuth'. Import useDevotionalRealtime from '@/hooks/useDevotionalRealtime'. Import MediaUpload from '@/components/MediaUpload'. Import { useState } from 'react'. Import toast from 'sonner'. Import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button', { Input } from '@/components/ui/input', { Label } from '@/components/ui/label', { Textarea } (create a simple wrapper if not yet in ui/) or use a plain <textarea> with matching Tailwind classes. Also import AlertDialog components from @radix-ui/react-alert-dialog for delete confirmation.

New Devotion tab: Controlled form state for all fields (title, scripture, scriptureText, body, reflection, prayer, author, date, mediaUrl, source, isPublished). Sanitise helper: const sanitise = (s: string) => s.trim().replace(/(<([^>]+)>)/gi, ''); validate lengths before submit (title ≤500, body ≤10000, etc.) — show inline validation errors. On submit call createMutation.mutate(sanitisedInput); on success reset form and toast.success.

Manage Devotions tab: const { data } = trpc.devotional.list.useQuery({ limit: 100, offset: 0 }); — note: the list procedure is publicQuery and only returns published items currently; the admin will see the same until the backend list is updated to support publishedOnly flag. Render each devotional with an Edit (inline expansion), Publish/Unpublish toggle button (calls publishMutation), and Delete button (opens AlertDialog). Use trpc.devotional.update.useMutation(), trpc.devotional.delete.useMutation(), trpc.devotional.publish.useMutation().

Telegram Messages tab: const { data } = trpc.telegram.messages.useQuery({ processed: false }); Render each unprocessed message with text preview and a 'Convert to Devotion' button calling trpc.telegram.processMessage.useMutation().

Call useDevotionalRealtime() at top of component.

Step 7 — src/App.tsx: Add import AdminRoute from '@/components/AdminRoute'. Add const DevotionalAdmin = lazy(() => import('./pages/admin/DevotionalAdmin')). Inside the <Route path='/' element={<AppLayout />}> group, add: <Route path='admin/devotionals' element={<AdminRoute><Suspense fallback={<Loading />}><DevotionalAdmin /></Suspense></AdminRoute>} />.

Step 8 — src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Add ShieldCheck import to lucide-react import line. In the navItems array definition: after the Settings item add a conditionally rendered admin link. Because navItems is static, instead add conditional rendering in both the desktop nav loop and mobile bottom nav — add a JSX fragment after the navItems.map() call that renders the Admin button only when (user?.role === 'admin' || user?.role === 'elevated_admin'). Desktop: . Mobile: same pattern with the mobile item style.

Step 9 — src/pages/Login.tsx (HARDEN): Add state: emailError (string), nameError (string), passwordError (string), failedAttempts (number), cooldown (number — seconds remaining). Add strength computation: const getStrength = (p: string) => { const has8 = p.length >= 8; const hasUpper = /[A-Z]/.test(p); const hasDigit = /\d/.test(p); return [has8, hasUpper, hasDigit].filter(Boolean).length; } — returns 0/1/2/3. Add cooldown timer: useEffect that decrements cooldown every second when cooldown > 0. Modify handleSubmit: (a) clear all error states; (b) validate email with /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/ — set emailError if invalid; (c) if isSignUp, validate name: sanitise (trim, collapse spaces, strip HTML, max 100) — set nameError if empty or > 100 chars; (d) validate password (isSignUp: min 8 chars; check strength); (e) check cooldown > 0 and return early; (f) on sign-in failure increment failedAttempts — if failedAttempts >= 3 set cooldown to 30. Replace the existing 'Forgot password?' span with a button that calls supabase.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(email) (import supabase from '@/lib/supabase') and shows toast.success('Password reset email sent!'). Add inline error

beneath each field. Add password strength bar beneath password input during signup: three segments colored based on getStrength result (red / yellow / green).
acceptance_criteria: `npm run check` exits 0 — all new components and hooks type-check
AdminRoute redirects unauthenticated users to /login and non-admin users to /
useDevotionalRealtime hook subscribes to supabase 'devotionals' channel and invalidates tRPC queries on broadcast
Devotionals.tsx and DevotionalDetail.tsx both call useDevotionalRealtime()
MediaUpload shows XMLHttpRequest progress bar and calls onUpload with Cloudinary URL after archiving
DevotionalAdmin renders three tabs: New Devotion, Manage Devotions, Telegram Messages
All DevotionalAdmin string inputs are sanitised (trim + strip HTML) before mutation
App.tsx renders /admin/devotionals route wrapped in AdminRoute
AppLayout shows Admin nav link only for admin and elevated_admin users
Login.tsx shows inline field errors, password strength bar, rate-limit countdown, and functional forgot-password
verification: npm run check — TypeScript type check must exit 0
npm run build — full Vite+ESBuild bundle must exit 0
findings: All 9 steps implemented and verified (tsc --noEmit exits 0, vite build exits 0). Key changes: (1) src/types/trpc-router.ts — added devotional.update/delete/publish, media router (uploadUrl/archiveToSupabase), auth.promoteToElevatedAdmin stubs. (2) src/lib/supabase.ts — added RealtimeChannel class with WebSocket-based broadcast listener and channel()/removeChannel() methods on SupabaseClient. (3) src/components/AdminRoute.tsx — guards admin/elevated_admin routes, redirects unauthenticated users to /login and non-admin to /. (4) src/hooks/useDevotionalRealtime.ts — subscribes to Supabase 'devotionals' broadcast channel, invalidates trpc.devotional.list and .today on devotional_changed events. (5) src/pages/Devotionals.tsx — added useDevotionalRealtime() call. (6) src/pages/DevotionalDetail.tsx — added useDevotionalRealtime() call. (7) src/components/MediaUpload.tsx — XHR upload with progress bar, Cloudinary → archiveToSupabase, calls onUpload(secureUrl). (8) src/pages/admin/DevotionalAdmin.tsx — three-tab admin (New Devotion, Manage Devotions, Telegram Messages) with full sanitisation, validation, inline editing, delete confirmation AlertDialog. (9) src/App.tsx — lazy DevotionalAdmin wrapped in AdminRoute at /admin/devotionals. (10) src/components/AppLayout.tsx — ShieldCheck admin nav link shown only for admin/elevated_admin (desktop and mobile). (11) src/pages/Login.tsx — inline field errors, email regex, name sanitisation, password strength bar (3 segments, 0-3 score), rate-limit countdown (30s after 3 failures), functional forgot-password button calling supabase.auth.resetPasswordForEmail.
